comment: Stage-0 donor pins, enforced by invariant I11 (docs/fusion/FUSION_PLAN.md). The SHAs are permanent: they identify exactly the donor trees the fusion copied from, so every attribution claim in docs/fusion/ATTRIBUTION.md stays checkable with `git show <sha>`. Decision Rule D5 (upstream drift / re-sync) is retired, see docs/fusion/DECISIONS.md. The gate needs only `path` and `sha`. Updated 2026-07-29: the sibling checkouts were renamed to lowercase, and Cambrian was republished and has resumed development, so the gate now asserts that each pinned SHA is still reachable from the donor's HEAD rather than that HEAD still equals it — rationale in scripts/check_donors_clean.py.
